question: The largest gland in human body is
solution:
The correct answer is **__liver__**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The liver** is the **largest gland** in the body and is an accessory organ of the **digestive system.**
 
• It is situated on the **right side** of the **abdomen**.
 
• The liver is **split into the left** and the **right **lobe separated by the **falciform ligament**.
 
• The hepatocytes, cells of the liver have a unique potential to reproduce in response to any liver injury. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **The pancreas** is the **2nd largest gland** in the human body.
 
• **The pituitary gland** or hypophysis is the **smallest gland** in the human body.
 
• **The Pancreas** is the **largest endocrine** gland in the body.
 
• **The skin** is the body's **largest organ in the body.**
